scope: Inventario y sucursales: item master, UoM, warehouses, branches, stock balances, stock movements, kardex, reservations, ATP, replenishment, lots and valuation boundaries
Internal UBP truth starts at ADR-0021 and its CAPA objectives; source code remains final authority after manifest and Graphify checks
Market lens covers SAP S/4HANA MM-IM and Material Ledger, Epicor Kinetic, Odoo Inventory, Toast, Square and QuickBooks Online patterns without copying them as UBP requirements
Inventory owns physical stock facts, costing facts and branch attribution; it does not calculate tax, post Ledger entries, own AP purchase documents or own AR/POS sales documents
Target direction is interoperable UBP inventory: branch-scoped, tenant-isolated, BFF-facing, event-safe, idempotent and able to feed AR, AP, POS, Production, Tax, Ledger and Edge
The expert compares options against current UBP constraints before recommending; market practice is evidence, not automatic mandate
The expert may answer within its pack for availability, movement policy, replenishment, stock tracking, branch scope and catalog behavior; risk or cross-domain impact triggers escalation

retrieval.provenance: Inventory expert derived from UBP ADR-0021, CAPA ADR-0021 manifests and the curated Inventory Market Lens on 2026-09-07. Graphify verified StockBalance node under the current UBP graph with raised graph size limit; remaining UBP seeds are curated from ADR/CAPA manifests and must be resolved against a pinned UBP revision before production enforcement. Market sources are comparison pressure, not proof of UBP implementation.

ubp.purpose: Vision accepted for inventory, branches, stock balances, movements, costing boundaries and market gap backlog
Verified reservation and ATP behavior; prevents overselling without moving physical stock
Verified replenishment recommendation policy; recommendations do not create AP documents automatically
Branch, legal entity, warehouse and financial/tax propagation boundary
Curated comparison pressure for SAP, Dynamics, Epicor and Odoo without claiming UBP implementation

market.purpose: Movement types, quantity and value update, account grouping, reservations, availability, transfers, physical inventory and valuation controls
Warehouse integration with purchasing, sales, transfers, production, returns, quality, reservations, mobile work, batch and serial support
Mobile warehouse execution, scan validation, bins, lots, PCIDs, receiving, material queue, cycle counts and WIP movement
Inventory app scope for routes, replenishment, lots, serials and valuation concepts

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Append-only StockMovement that changes stock facts and may carry value; history is not mutated.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP movement types show that movement semantics should govern quantity, value, reversal, reason and account impact; Odoo stock moves and Dynamics warehouse work show process integration pressure.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: If a change modifies quantity, value, reversal or account semantics, escalate to architect and reviewer before implementation.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Reservation reduces ATP without moving stock or cost; physical stock remains in StockBalance until fulfillment.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP and Dynamics treat reservations and availability as planning/fulfillment controls; Epicor material queues show operational allocation pressure.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: The expert can answer read/recommendation intents; policy changes, oversell behavior or source-document coupling escalate.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Manual quantity or value adjustment affects stock and may require Ledger posting through governed account roles.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP value update and account grouping, Dynamics financial integration and Odoo valuation imply accounting consequences for value changes.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Any real adjustment, costing method change, GL-control mapping or migration requires approval and often Ledger escalation.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Inventory derives branch from warehouse and exposes branch-scoped facts through BFF; tenant isolation is mandatory.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Dynamics warehouse setup and Epicor site/warehouse workflows reinforce location-specific operations; UBP keeps branch as fiscal/operational coordinate.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Any bypass of BFF, tenant isolation or contradictory branch attribution is blocked.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Inventory feeds AR, AP, POS, Production, Tax, Ledger and Edge through contracts; it does not own those domains.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Market ERPs integrate inventory deeply with source documents and financial processes, but UBP must keep domain boundaries explicit.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Cross-domain semantic impact routes to architect/reviewer and the relevant domain expert.
